title: Green dashboards and missed dates in the Carrier Solutions Division at Tessaline Logistics Software

organization.size: approx. 1,100 staff; three product divisions (Carrier Solutions - CSD, approx. 139 staff after February 2026; Freight Visibility - FVD; Warehouse Systems - WSD) sharing one Platform Engineering team of 38 approved positions

presentingRequest: My division is at 95% project health on our portfolio dashboard, yet we keep missing customer dates because Platform Engineering can't deliver what we need on time. I'd like your help building the case to the executive team to move 12 platform engineers into Carrier Solutions under my direct line, and to put service-level agreements with penalties on whatever remains of Platform. - SVP, Carrier Solutions Division

evidence.text: 'Our portfolio dashboard shows 21 of 22 active projects green - that is 95% project health. My teams execute. Where we fall down is customer dates, and that is Platform. Of the 16 customer commitments we missed this year, 12 were waiting on Platform Engineering. Yes, the dashboard is self-reported, but my project leads are professionals and they know their projects better than anyone. Internal Audit looked at six projects; that is an anecdote, not a portfolio.'

evidence.source: CSD portfolio dashboard: snapshot history and methodology note (document, retrieved 2026-10-31)
evidence.text: Status (green/amber/red) is entered weekly by each project lead and reviewed by that lead's director; there are no objective criteria (no milestone or date thresholds) behind the colours. CSD's 13 project leads report to 3 directors, who report to the SVP. Green share by snapshot: 2025-10-31: 14 of 22 (64%; 6 amber, 2 red); 2025-12-31: 20 of 22 (91%); every month-end in 2026: between 90% and 95%; 2026-10-31: 21 of 22 (95%; 1 amber). No project has been reported red since 2025-12-05.

evidence.source: SVP memo to CSD directors and project leads, dated 2025-11-03 (document)
evidence.text: 'Effective immediately: any project reported Amber or Red must be presented by its project lead at my Monday portfolio review, with a recovery plan, the Platform ticket number that is blocking you, and a recovery date. I don't want colours, I want solutions. Projects that cannot explain their status will be reviewed for leadership changes.'

For CSD project leads (13) and directors (3), 25% of variable pay is 'Portfolio Health', defined as the percentage of the person's weekly status reports that are green. The metric was set by the SVP. The Freight Visibility (FVD) and Warehouse Systems (WSD) divisions' equivalent scorecards use 'customer commitments met on time' taken from the Customer Success commitment register instead.

evidence.source: Customer commitment register (system of record maintained by Customer Success, outside all three product divisions; dates are the release dates agreed in customer contracts)
evidence.text: Customer commitments met on time. CSD: 2025-Q3 4 of 9; 2025-Q4 3 of 8; 2026-Q1 3 of 8; 2026-Q2 3 of 9; 2026-Q3 3 of 8 (2026 Jan-Sep: 9 of 25, 36%). FVD: 2026 H1 18 of 20, 2026-Q3 9 of 11 (27 of 31, 87%). WSD: 2026 H1 14 of 16, 2026-Q3 6 of 8 (20 of 24, 83%). FVD and WSD combined: H1 89%, Q3 79%. The 'primary delay reason' field is filled in by the owning division's account team; for CSD's 16 missed 2026 commitments it reads 'platform dependency' for 12.

evidence.source: Platform Engineering request-ticket data, 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30 (ticketing system export)
evidence.text: 406 requests: CSD 138 (34%), FVD 142, WSD 126. Median business days between filing and the requester's own need-by date: CSD 6, FVD 21, WSD 17. Returned for incomplete specification: CSD 80 of 138 (58%), FVD 22 of 142 (15%), WSD 24 of 126 (19%); each return added a median 7 business days before work started. Share of requests that were integration/API work: CSD 61%, FVD+WSD 58%. Delivered by need-by date: FVD 84%, WSD 80%, CSD 60 of 138 (43%). Within CSD: requests filed complete and at least 15 business days ahead (n=31) were delivered by need-by date 87% of the time (Q3 alone: 8 of 10); all other CSD requests (n=107): 31%. System note: need-by dates are entered by the requester, and a 'returned for incomplete spec' status cannot be set unless the requester acknowledges it in the tool.

evidence.source: Platform Engineering staffing and cycle-time records (HR system and ticketing system)
evidence.text: 38 approved positions. 3 positions vacant since 2026-06-01 (two resignations, one internal transfer); backfill frozen by the company-wide hiring freeze of 2026-05-20. 2 engineers seconded to the security remediation program from 2026-07-06 to 2026-10-16. Effective staffing therefore 35 in June and 33 from July to mid-October. Median cycle time for complete requests, all divisions: 2026 H1 8 business days; 2026-Q3 11; October 2026 9.

'Carrier Solutions is 70% of our firefighting. They file the day before they need something, with half a spec, and then it is our fault. That said, we have been three heads short since June and two of my best people were seconded to the security program until mid-October. I won't pretend that hasn't slowed everybody down.'

evidence.source: People Analytics: engagement-survey participation and CSD headcount events (HR system)
evidence.text: Participation, CSD: 78% (annual survey, 2025-10); 49% (pulse, 2026-03); 40% (pulse, 2026-06); 31% (annual survey, 2026-10; 41 of 132 eligible). Company-wide: 74%, 72%, 70%, 71% on the same dates. Same survey vendor, questions and cadence across the company throughout. No survey ran between 2025-10 and 2026-03. CSD-only reduction in force on 2026-02-12: 12 roles (8% of the division); no other division had layoffs.

evidence.source: CSD free-text comments, annual engagement survey 2026-10 (anonymous)
evidence.text: 23 comments. 9 concern status reporting, e.g. 'Green-shifting is how you survive the Monday review'; 'Projects stay green until the week the customer finds out'; 'One lead reported red in December, presented at the Monday review and was moved off the account in January. Nobody has reported red since.' 6 concern the February layoffs, e.g. 'After February nobody wants to be visible.' 8 concern other topics (tooling, office move, pay bands).

Random sample of 6 of the 21 projects shown green on the 2026-08-31 CSD dashboard, compared with baselined milestone plans and engineering-tracker data. 4 of 6 were behind their baseline by 3, 5, 6 and 9 weeks; in all 4 the slippage was visible in milestone data at least 4 weeks before the audit while the dashboard stayed green. 2 of the 4 had a blocked Platform dependency; in both, the Platform request had been filed 8 and 11 business days after the project's own planned integration start and had been returned once for incomplete specification. The other 2 were late because of internal scope growth and a vacant QA lead role. Audit caveat: the sample is small and was not designed to estimate a portfolio-wide rate.

'My project has been about five weeks behind since August. It is green. My director told me to keep it green until after the customer's quarterly business review on 2026-10-14 so we didn't spook them. I don't know whether that came from the SVP or not. The Platform request? Honestly, we filed it the week we needed it because our design wasn't settled. Once we resubmitted a full spec, Platform turned it around in about nine days.'

evidence.source: CSD Director of Program Delivery, one of the three CSD directors who review project leads' weekly status (interview, 2026-10-21)
evidence.text: 'Green means the lead is confident they can land the date - leads know their projects best. The SVP was genuinely surprised by the audit result; he asked me whether the leads were lying to him. We do lean on Platform heavily, and they have been short-staffed this year.'

'We map our Platform dependencies at quarterly planning and file tickets four to six weeks ahead using Platform's template. Platform has been slower since the summer - three or four extra days on a typical ticket - but that hasn't broken a customer date we planned properly. The two dates we missed in Q3 were both ones where we filed late ourselves.'

evidence.source: Customer Success escalation log, 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31 (system of record)
evidence.text: Formal customer escalations: CSD 7, FVD 2, WSD 1. In 5 of the 7 CSD escalations, the customer raised the slippage before the project had been marked amber or red; at the time of escalation all 5 projects were green on the CSD dashboard.

hypotheses.text: The CSD portfolio dashboard (95% green) is an accurate picture of CSD project health.
Platform Engineering is the primary cause of CSD's missed customer commitments.
CSD project status is being systematically inflated ('green-shifting') because of pressure and incentives on project leads who report up to the SVP.
Platform Engineering has a genuine capacity constraint in 2026 that has modestly slowed delivery for all divisions, but it is secondary to CSD's delivery problem.
The fall in CSD engagement-survey participation is mainly survey fatigue rather than anything specific to CSD.
The SVP knowingly directed project leads to report projects green when they were behind.

edges.from: Platform Engineering capacity shortfall (vacancies and secondments from June 2026)
edges.to: CSD's low on-time rate for customer commitments

edges.from: CSD reporting regime (2025-11-03 red/amber presentation memo and 2026 'Portfolio Health' bonus weighting)
edges.to: Inflated green status on the CSD portfolio dashboard

edges.from: CSD's late and under-specified Platform requests

actions.text: Transfer 12 Platform engineers into CSD under the SVP and impose penalty-bearing SLAs on the remaining Platform team, as requested.

Replace self-reported RAG status with objective milestone-and-dependency criteria validated by a function outside the CSD reporting line, and replace the 'Portfolio Health' (percent-green) bonus measure with commitments met on time from the Customer Success register.
Seek an exception to the hiring freeze to backfill Platform Engineering's three vacant positions.
Remove the SVP from the division-head role for misrepresenting portfolio status to the executive team.
Ask HR to use survey metadata to identify the authors of the anonymous 'green-shifting' comments so their claims can be verified with them directly.

evidenceRequests.text: Re-baselined audit of all 22 active CSD projects against milestone plans
SVP's written communications to CSD directors and project leads about status reporting, Nov 2025 - Oct 2026
Externally conducted confidential interviews with current and former CSD project leads, including the lead reportedly moved off an account
Platform Engineering sprint velocity and story-point burndown charts
CSD customer NPS scores by account
Dashboard status-change log: date, author and any overrides for every RAG change since Oct 2025
